content.title: How to live stream Angels vs. Astros MLB game free on ‘Friday Night Baseball’ on Apple TV+
content.text: TV & StreamingUpdated: Mar. 27, 2026, 5:50 p.m.Published: Mar. 27, 2026, 5:49 p.m.Los Angeles Angels' Mike Trout, right, celebrates with third base coach Keith Johnson after hitting a home run against the Houston Astros during the seventh inning of an opening-day baseball game Thursday, March 26, 2026, in Houston. (AP Photo/David J. Phillip)APBy Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Los Angeles Angels are back in Houston Friday night for the second of a three-game series against the Astros. The game is scheduled to start at 8:10 p.m. ET (7:10 p.m. CT) on “Friday Night Baseball” on Apple TV+ (free trial). How to watch MLB on Apple TV+: Live streams of the Angels vs. Astros game are available on Apple TV+, which comes with a free trial. After the trial, an Apple TV+ subscription costs $12.99 per month.Apple TV+ will carry a total of 50 Major League Baseball games in 2026, two per Friday night for a span of 25 weeks.Los Angeles Angels (1-0) at Houston Astros (0-1)MLB matchup at a glanceWhen: Friday, March 27 at 8:10 p.m. ET (7:10 p.m. CT)Where: Daikin Park, Houston, TexasTV channel: N/ALive streams: Apple TV+ (free trial)Right-hander Jose Soriano led a staff-wide effort to shut out the Astros (3-0) in Thursday’s season opener, giving up two hits with seven strikeouts and four walks in six scoreless frames. Four Angels relievers combined to work three more shutout innings and closer Jordan Romano registered his first save of the season with a hitless ninth inning. Angels vs. Astros on Apple TV+: Watch with a free trialThe Astros are listed as solid betting favorites (-169) to even the score on Friday at their own Daikin Park. Houston will start right-hander Mike Burrows, who went 2-4 with a 3.94 ERA in 23 games (19 starts) for the Pittsburgh Pirates, while LA will give the ball to lefty Yusei Kikuchi (7-11, 3.99 ERA). The Angels vs. Astros game is available on Apple TV+, which comes with a free trial. After that, an Apple TV+ subscription costs $12.99 per month.
